content_record.title: Fat's hidden clock: how ageing adipose tissue drives metabolic decline
content_record.editorial_body: A new review maps the cellular remodelling of fat tissue with age, linking senescent cells and immune shifts to disease risk, and weighs interventions from caloric restriction to senolytics. Ageing remodels fat tissue: adipocyte hypertrophy, progenitor exhaustion, immune infiltration. Senescent cells in fat secrete SASP factors, driving chronic inflammation and insulin resistance. Caloric restriction, metformin, GLP-1 agonists, senolytics may counter adipose ageing. This signal is based on Adipose tissue ageing: implications for metabolic health and lifespan. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context.
